essential_map_static_audit.note: Gate-object existence and legal commands do not prove that RTL SAIF hierarchy resolves onto those mappings.

findings.detail: All 7,035 map commands are syntactically valid, unique and point at linked gate objects.  Nevertheless only 3,734/22,800 nets and 799/4,100 sequential outputs are annotated from the activity file; u_matcher, u_matcher/u_balanced and u_adapter are None Found.
findings.repair_gate: Export and test a hierarchy-complete RTL-to-gate map, or generate gate-level SAIF. Require an independent mapped-annotation admission before update_power.
findings.title: Essential map is legal and targets existing gate objects, but does not resolve most hierarchical RTL SAIF state

findings.detail: PrimeTime defines report_switching_activity -coverage as nets with at least one toggle. In a deliberately sparse workload this is not identical to name-mapping completeness. The current run has 16.38 percent directly from activity, 7.46 percent implied and 21.76 percent nonzero-toggle coverage.
findings.repair_gate: Report mapping completeness, origin categories, sequential coverage and nonzero-toggle coverage separately; keep the fail-closed 95 percent bar until the metric is explicitly repaired and independently reviewed.
findings.title: The current 95 percent gate mixes annotation completeness with nonzero-toggle coverage

findings.detail: DC still emits a nonempty 7,035-command essential map, but the sealed saif_map report has no reportable objects. This inconsistency must be disclosed and prevents treating export size as coverage evidence.
findings.repair_gate: Use PrimeTime annotation results, not map-entry count, as the downstream admission evidence.
findings.title: saif_map -report itself says no objects found

findings.detail: Area/cell/FF/logic/timing exactly match M416, but the design has zero macros, ideal clock and zero wire area. This is not physical or paper PPA.
findings.repair_gate: Retain the pre-macro label and keep macro, CTS/interconnect and post-layout claims separate.
findings.title: M431 reproduces a pre-macro ideal-clock ZeroWireload screen only

findings.detail: The DC log repeatedly reports cells not characterized for internal power. It does not invalidate logic QoR, but any later PTPX run must quantify affected instances/arcs before paper power use.
findings.repair_gate: Audit library power characterization coverage during the eventual mapped PTPX admission.
findings.title: The target library emits PWR-24 internal-power characterization warnings

recommended_path.comparison: Full mapping is cheaper and preserves the RTL workload; gate SAIF is more robust to flattening but costs simulation time and requires gate-level X/reset/protocol revalidation.
recommended_path.fallback: Run zero-delay gate simulation for the admitted M425R4 subset and generate gate-level SAIF if full mapping cannot cover hierarchical state.
recommended_path.first: Try a full, hierarchy-aware DC/SVF-derived mapping export and rerun annotation-only diagnostics.
